CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 2974.

SHANGHAI, 22nd August 1936.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. B. REGISTRY / S. B. D. 7499 / 24 8 36）

Sir,

I still have to thank you for the report of the Special
Branch, S.2, dated August 13, 1936, concerning Mrs. Sophie de Vries.
The latter called at my office on August 21, 1936, and re-
gistered with this Consulate General. She is indeed in possession
of a passport, issued at Soerabaia on July 27, 1934, under No.
906, extended at Brussels for a period of two years ending June
22, 1937.

She stated that during the last seven years of her stay in
Soerabaia she had been employed as a steno-typist with the
American Consulate, the Gulf Petroleum Co. and Messrs. Fraser &
Eaton, but that owing to her age she found it difficult to obtain
further employment in this line and therefore proceeded to Paris
to study hairdressing and beauty-culture.

It is quite true too that she shows a certain reluctance to
speak about her former marriage.

There was nothing to show that she was interested in politics
or conditions in China.

（批：S.2. / Note thanx & Reg / for fil. / d.R. / J.B. 24/8）

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处为签名〕
Chinese Secretary.

T. Robertson, Esquire,
Officer in charge of Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / 24 AUG. 1936 / CRIME BRANCH）

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

第 2974 号。

上海，1936年8月22日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / S. B. 登记处 / S. B. D. 7499 / 36年8月24日）

先生：

我仍需感谢您就苏菲·德弗里斯（Sophie de Vries）女士一事，转来特别支部S.2于1936年8月13日提交的报告。后者于1936年8月21日造访本馆，并在本总领事馆进行了登记。她确实持有一本护照，该护照于1934年7月27日在泗水签发，编号为906，后经布鲁塞尔延期两年，有效期至1937年6月22日。

她称，在泗水居住的最后七年期间，她曾受雇于美国领事馆、海湾石油公司（Gulf Petroleum Co.）以及弗雷泽与伊顿商行（Messrs. Fraser & Eaton），担任速记打字员；但由于年龄原因，她发现难以在此领域继续就业，因此前往巴黎学习美发和美容文化。

她确实对谈及前段婚姻表现出某种不愿提及的态度。

没有任何迹象表明她对政治或中国局势感兴趣。

（批注：S.2. / 知悉并致谢 / 归档 / d.R. / J.B. 8月24日）

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

〔此处为签名〕
中文秘书。

T. Robertson 先生，
特别支部主管，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1936年8月24日 / 刑事科）

Special Branch
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 7499
8.26th, 8 36
Date August 13, 36

Subject Mrs. Sophie de Vries, Netherlander.

Made by D.S. Pitts. Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

Mrs. Sophie de VRIES, aged 48, a Netherlands subject,
arrived in Shanghai from Singapore on May 23, 1936 as a pass-
enger on board the Lloyd Triestino's m.v. "Victoria." She
stayed for one night (May 23) at the Broadway Mansions, after
which she removed to Room 15, Avenue Hall, 1400 Avenue Road,
where she is still residing.

Until about 2½ years ago, Mrs. de Vries was unhappily
married to a Netherlander named de KLOSTER, who held a very
prominent position in Soerabaya, Netherlands East Indies. Due
to de Kloster's infidelity and general unhappiness, Mrs. de
Kloster, as she was then known, secured a divorce from her
husband in the Netherlands East Indies and resumed her maiden
name of de Vries, but preferred to be known as Mrs. and not
Miss de Vries.

After obtaining her divorce, Mrs. de Vries, who
working as a stenographer in Java during her married life
had saved a considerable amount of money, made her way to
Europe and visited the Hague, Brussels and Paris in order to
study hairdressing and beauty-culture. She remained in
Europe for nearly two years and eventually obtained a diploma
in Paris which states that she is an expert in the art of
facial make-up and hairdressing.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 14 AUG (CRIME BRANCH)）

She returned to the East in the Spring of this year
and made a short stop at Singapore, whence she made a trip
to Soerabaya to see various friends and acquaintances, after
which she continued her journey to Shanghai.

She is doing fairly well in the ladies' hairdressing
business at present, her clients visiting her at her home address.
She manages to earn sufficient from this venture to live quite

日期 1936年8月13日

事由 苏菲·德弗里斯（Sophie de Vries）女士，荷兰籍。

撰写人 D.S. Pitts。呈送人 副督察长 J. Boyne。

苏菲·德弗里斯（de VRIES）女士，48岁，荷兰公民，于1936年5月23日作为乘客乘坐劳埃德·特里斯蒂诺轮船公司（Lloyd Triestino）的“维多利亚”号机动船（m.v. "Victoria"）从新加坡抵达上海。她在百老汇大厦（Broadway Mansions）住了一晚（5月23日），随后搬至爱文义路（Avenue Road）1400号爱文义公寓（Avenue Hall）15室，目前仍居住于此。

直到约两年前，德弗里斯女士与一名名为德克洛斯特（de KLOSTER）的荷兰人婚姻不幸，该人在荷属东印度群岛的泗水身居要职。由于德克洛斯特的不忠及总体上的不幸生活，当时被称为德克洛斯特夫人的她从丈夫那里获得了在荷属东印度群岛的离婚判决，并恢复了婚前姓氏德弗里斯（de Vries），但她更倾向于被称为德弗里斯夫人（Mrs.），而非德弗里斯小姐（Miss）。

获得离婚后，德弗里斯女士在已婚期间曾在爪哇担任速记员并积蓄了相当一笔钱，她前往欧洲，访问了海牙、布鲁塞尔和巴黎，以学习美发和美容文化。她在欧洲停留了近两年，最终在巴黎获得了一份文凭，证明她是面部化妆和美发艺术的专家。

（印：副总监 8月14日（刑事科））

她于今年春季返回东方，在新加坡短暂停留，随后前往泗水拜访多位朋友和熟人，之后继续行程前往上海。

目前她的女士美发生意经营得相当不错，客户会上门到她的住址接受服务。她通过这项事业赚取的收入足以维持相当

comfortably, and she is still in possession of a fair amount
of money saved during her married life.
        She has a number of friends in Shanghai, all being
quite well-known and of a respectable character.    In this
connection it should be mentioned that Mrs. de Vries has passed
several months in Shanghai on different occasions prior to her
divorce.
        As regards her daily life, it would appear that
Mrs. de Vries is a thoroughly respectable lady, there being
no indication that she is anything other than a woman who
wants to forget her unhappy past, make a little money and
live quietly.    She neither smokes nor drinks and has no
love affairs.    She is also of a very religious frame of mind,
attending the Christian Science Church, 1647 Avenue Road,
very regularly.    It can be said that she leads an almost
featureless existence for she rarely ventures outside her
home after dark, save perhaps to go to the theatre occasion-
ally, and even then when she does do this she is always accom-
panied by a lady acquaintance.    In brief she leads a thoroughly
quiet and retiring life.
        Regarding that information received from a certain
source to the effect that she is to be seen typing documents
continually, I have to report that this statement is definitely
untrue., for although Mrs. de Vries is in possession of a
typewriter, she rarely uses it and is reliably said to be a
very casual correspondent.    Further her linguistic abilities
though fair, are by no means up to the required standard
demanded of anyone connected with regular correspondence or
journalistic work.

舒适的生活，且她仍拥有相当数量的资金，这是她在已婚期间积蓄下来的。
        她在上海有一些朋友，均为知名且品行端正之人。在此需提及的是，在离婚之前，德弗里斯女士曾分几次在上海度过数月。
        关于她的日常生活，德弗里斯女士似乎是一位完全正派的女士，没有任何迹象表明她不是一个只想忘记不幸过去、赚点小钱并安静生活的女人。她不吸烟也不饮酒，没有恋爱关系。她的思想也非常虔诚，非常定期地参加位于爱文义路1647号的基督教科学派教会（Christian Science Church）。可以说，她的生活几乎平淡无奇，因为除了偶尔去看戏外，她天黑后很少外出，而即使去看戏，也总是由一位女性熟人陪同。简而言之，她过着一种极其安静和隐居的生活。
        关于从某消息来源获悉的她被看到持续打字文件的信息，我必须报告称该说法肯定不实，因为虽然德弗里斯女士拥有一台打字机，但她很少使用，且据可靠消息称，她写信非常随意。此外，她的语言能力虽然尚可，但远未达到从事常规通信或新闻工作所要求的标准。

It is quite possible that the informant was aware of
the fact that Mrs. de Vries was formerly Mrs. de Kloster,
and was under the impression that there was something
strange or even suspicious about her non-employment of her
married name, but since Mrs. de Vries holds Netherlands
passport No. 906 issued by the Netherlands Authorities in
Soerabaya on July 27, 1934 in that name, any such suspicions
would appear to be groundless.

〔签名：Ja Pries〕
D. S.
